name: GLIAC Cross Country Championships
where: Hammond, IN · PNW Cross Country Course
headline: GLIAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Grand Valley State swept the titles with 19 points in both races: the men ahead of Saginaw Valley (77) and Michigan Tech (101), the women ahead of Michigan Tech (78) and Saginaw Valley (84). Grand Valley’s Flynn Pumpa (24:15.1) and Allie Arnsman (20:35.6) won the individual races.
